body:
Registration’s board and visit forms use shared Clean Look surfaces, a visible board heading and responsive field targets. Edit stays secondary when Send to Waiting is available. This is the existing four-page presentation foundation; the later full demo workspace/content composition is a separate slice.

Normal main refresh preserves the original nine-file scope. All four page script blocks remain byte-identical to current main: no workflow, payload, branch guard, permissions or clinical behavior changes. The final page-local correction gives four remaining controls a 44px phone/tablet minimum: quick identification type, Consultation/OTC buttons and Edit’s member/staff reference. Shared controls are unchanged.

Existing assertion change under the owner’s standing delegated technical approval: REG6’s exact quick-identification select class expectation adds max-lg:min-h-11, retaining full-width, mobile stacking and desktop joined-corner checks. The original owner-approved five appearance groups and I2 Panel-reference expectation remain. No assertion is removed; Emergency Contact, Family and TRI2 remain separate.

Validation: all 2,205 frontend tests pass with zero skips; full TypeScript, production build, changed-page lint/format and diff checks pass. Independent source review cleared the exact three-file target patch 7384c96d; scripts still match main. Independent actual-browser verification at this exact head passed 24 control measurements across 390/768/1440 widths and both themes, with 12 captures: four controls are 44px on phone/tablet, and 36px or 40px on desktop. Focus, unobstructed centers, no document overflow and no JavaScript errors passed; no patient/visit writes occurred. Create used an authorized synthetic CA; Edit used an authorized synthetic Director and Waiting visit after Serving was correctly denied. These are bounded control checks, not whole-page demo parity approval. Full backend tests are not a local claim for this script-preserving presentation slice; exact-head repository CI remains required before merge.
